english: Scooting collects Ammo Bricks, Gambit and Pale Heart Motes, and Crests within 15 meters. It also grants 25 Handling and Reload Speed for 10 seconds.

source.text:
2 Piece | Scoot to Loot

Upon scooting:
Pick ups Ammo Bricks within 15 meters. Will also pick up Gambit/Pale Heart Motes and Crests.
+25 Handling and +25 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.
